lede: No elevator pitches required. Productive Chill invites young professionals and creatives to talk honestly about their projects, including the ones that didn't work out.
body:
Most networking events expect you to show up polished. **Productive Chill**, a networking session for creatives and young professionals that landed on our radar, asks for something different: bring the project you're working on, whether it's finished, in progress or one that failed, and talk about what you learned.

## Networking for creatives who don't like networking

The organisers pitch it as "networking for people who don't like networking". In their words, Productive Chill is "a space for young professionals and creatives to experiment, share and critique ideas or projects." Those projects "can be ongoing, complete or unsuccessful". If you've learned something from the process, they want to hear it. If you're stuck, they suggest you might benefit from applying to join a session.

The invitation is deliberately wide. The post name-checks a startup bro, a singer-songwriter, a fashion designer, a writer and even a pediatrician. The common thread isn't your industry. It's loving what you do, trying to work out what you want to do, or looking for the right people to help you do it.

## How to join a Productive Chill session

This isn't a walk-in event. The caption is blunt: without registration and confirmation, there is no entry. Applications go through the [Productive Chill application form](https://forms.gle/ASzR1SEBQ39NpbUz7), which is also linked in the organisers' bio.

The cover graphic adds one more detail: a line reading "Saturdays, 3 PM" sits above the Productive Chill wordmark, next to a reminder to check the registration link. The venue name on the graphic is cropped off, so confirm the location when you apply.

- **Who it's for:** young professionals and creatives from any field
- **What to bring:** an idea or project, whether ongoing, complete or unsuccessful
- **When:** Saturdays, 3 PM (as shown on the cover)
- **Entry:** registration and confirmation required

## Why it stood out

Creative communities often grow out of small, informal rooms where people can talk about work without pretending everything is going well. Productive Chill fits alongside other community-built events in our [Events & Radar](topic:events) coverage, from the free [Dow Run Club 5K community run](post:dow-run-club-5k-community-run-gulshan) to the [Open to All art exhibition at Alliance Française de Dhaka](post:alliance-francaise-dhaka-open-art-exhibition).
